meta.name: Patient Seventeen
meta.description: Meet a surgeon who claims to remove highly advance implants, nanotechnology microchips imbedded by aliens, non-humans monitoring our earth. Discover the world of abductions, scalar wave transmissions and a program to study or manipulate the human race. Armed with a patient, a scalpel, black lights and a stud finder –  we seek to verify the authenticity of this alleged Off-World Implant Technology.
